Test Steps: Enter valid name, DOB, mobile, PAN and address; click Continue
Expected Result: Applicant details are accepted and next step is displayed

Test Steps: Leave applicant name blank; complete other fields; submit
Expected Result: Inline mandatory-field validation is displayed and submission is blocked

Test Steps: Enter mobile number with 9 digits; submit
Expected Result: System rejects the mobile number and displays a validation message

Test Steps: Enter DOB resulting in applicant age below 21; continue
Expected Result: System blocks progression and displays age eligibility message

Test Steps: Enter monthly income below minimum; continue
Expected Result: System flags income as below the fictional minimum threshold

Test Steps: Enter minimum permitted loan amount; continue
Expected Result: Amount is accepted

Test Steps: Enter maximum permitted loan amount; continue
Expected Result: Amount is accepted

Test Steps: Enter amount above maximum; continue
Expected Result: System rejects the amount with a validation message

Test Steps: Do not upload address proof; submit application
Expected Result: Submission is blocked and missing document is identified

Preconditions: All required data and documents are valid
Test Steps: Submit application; capture generated ID
Expected Result: Unique application ID is generated and status is SUBMITTED

Test Steps: Reviewer opens application and selects Start Review
Expected Result: Status changes to UNDER_REVIEW

Preconditions: Application status is UNDER_REVIEW and meets exercise rules
Test Steps: Reviewer selects Approve and enters reason
Expected Result: Status changes to APPROVED and decision is recorded

Test Steps: Reviewer selects Reject and enters reason
Expected Result: Status changes to REJECTED and reason is recorded

Test Steps: Attempt to mark a SUBMITTED application as DISBURSED
Expected Result: System prevents disbursement and returns a clear validation error

Preconditions: Application exists in a valid state
Test Steps: Attempt an unsupported status transition
Expected Result: System rejects invalid transition; status remains unchanged

Test Steps: Send GET /applications/{applicationId}; inspect status and body
Expected Result: 200 response; response ID and status match stored application

Test Steps: Send GET using unknown application ID
Expected Result: 404 response with safe, useful error message

Test Steps: Query application table using generated ID
Expected Result: Exactly one row exists and status is SUBMITTED

Test Steps: Attempt duplicate insert using same unique application ID
Expected Result: Database rejects duplicate ID or application service prevents duplicate creation

Preconditions: New build deployed to test environment
Test Steps: Re-execute critical onboarding-to-submission test cases
Expected Result: Previously working core journey still behaves as expected
